name: shifting-dropdown

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the Products menu open with its three columns, the active tab pill and the nub.

tagline: Hover a nav tab and a wide menu drops below with a nub tracking the tab.
summary: A compact top navigation where hovering or clicking a tab opens a wide dropdown panel beneath it. The panel stays open while you move between tabs, sliding new content in sideways, and a small pointer follows the active tab.
appearance: Three short grey tab labels with tiny chevrons sit in a row on near-black. The active tab gains a dark rounded pill and an upturned chevron, and a wide bordered panel drops beneath with columns of links, or icon cells, and a small diamond nub pointing up.
behaviour: Hovering a tab opens the panel below with a fade and lift. Moving to another tab keeps the panel open while the new section slides in from the side and the nub glides under the chosen tab; leaving the row closes it.
demo_content: Tabs Products, Pricing and Blog; Products lists Startup, Scaleup and Enterprise links, Blog shows two posts.
search_phrases: nav bar with mega menu dropdown
hover tabs to open a wide menu
dropdown that stays open between tabs
sliding menu content on tab change
use_when: A marketing header has few top-level links but each needs a rich panel of sub-links, categories or posts.
avoid_when: It needs hover and a wide fixed panel, so narrow screens overflow and touch users cannot preview items.
customise: Tabs, their titles and panel contents are hardcoded arrays and components in the file; there are no props, so adding a tab or link means editing the source.
weight_why: Three buttons and one small panel; animation only runs while a menu is open.

a11y.note: Tabs are real buttons, but they lack aria-expanded and there is no Escape or arrow-key handling, so the panel is awkward from the keyboard.

issues: The blog card images load late, leaving an empty picture frame in one frame.
polish_why: A tidy mega-menu with smooth slides; the panel is fixed width and blog images load late.
